name: maximalism-ui
description: Maximalist restyling — loud is necessary but not sufficient: this language STACKS LAYERS. At most three loud layers (patterned ground, grain, one ornament) over an opaque content plane, role-bound accents that swap ramps between light and dark, oversized display type on a four-family budget, zero-blur chromatic shadows, a Calm mode toggle for WCAG 2.2.2, and a self-audit of every emitted pair against WCAG 2.2. One saturated bordered plane with no layer stack is brutalism-ui.
